nom: Clinique Jumbo All About Clean Liquid Facial Soap Cleanser - Mild

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the cleanser removes oil, dirt, and makeup thoroughly without over-drying, though one long-time user of the discontinued bar soap says the liquid version does not clean as deeply and leaves no 'squeaky clean' feeling.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry to very dry skin report the cleanser cleans without stripping, tightening, or flaking their skin, and describe it as hydrating or creamy; one 72-year-old with rosacea found it drying and painful on inflamed areas.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination or dry/combo skin report it balances oily and dry areas on the same face without irritation and can visibly shrink pores within weeks.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive, very sensitive, or reactive skin (including dermatitis-prone and rosacea-affected skin) mostly report no irritation, stinging, or dryness and call it gentle and fragrance-free; a few sensitive-skin reviewers say the liquid formula and its preservatives caused itching, redness, or made the soap intolerable.
segments.normal: Reviewers describing normal or slightly sensitive-normal skin report consistent, non-drying cleansing over long-term daily use.
segments.mature: One reviewer using this for her aging skin reports it feels light and removes makeup completely, without addressing wrinkles specifically.

concerns.aging: One mature-skin reviewer reports the cleanser is light and removes makeup fully; no reviewer reports a visible anti-aging effect from the cleanser itself.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers across dry, sensitive, and normal skin report the cleanser does not dry out or tighten the skin and leaves it hydrated or 'not stripped'; one reviewer with rosacea found it drying and painful, and one first-time tester felt her skin was left with a slick, itchy film.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or reactive redness give mixed reports: one says the liquid soap made inflamed areas hurt and another attributes redness/itching to the preservative system, while other sensitive-skin reviewers report no redness or irritation at all.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the cleanser as non-irritating and compatible with treatments like tretinoin that otherwise compromise the barrier, helping skin stay hydrated during use; a minority report itching or a lasting film suggesting barrier discomfort.
concerns.spots: Reviewers using this for hormonal or acne-prone skin report visibly smaller pores and a brighter, less dull complexion after use.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin (including a teen with sports-related breakouts) report fewer or contained breakouts and blemish-free skin; a couple of others still note occasional hormonal blemishes despite regular use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin mostly report it controls oil and residue without over-drying, though one reviewer of the discontinued bar soap felt the liquid oily-skin formula leaves a film and doesn't cut oil as well.

aspects.libelle: Leaves a film or slick feeling
New lid/cap design is loose or annoying

extraits.texte: I had my rosacea cleared up. Then I ran out of my extra gentle bar soap which was the only thing my face could tolerate. So in desperation I ordered this and I'm sorry but my skin can't tolerate this soap. I also tried the redness solution cleanser. Much to my unhappiness the liquid facial soap was drying and made my inflamed areas hurt. The redness solutions was not painful but my skin remained broken out. It's so embarrassing to be 72 years old suffering from broken out skin. Never any problems before my 60's. I would like to impress on Clinique how some of us relied on the Extra Mild Facial Bar Soap. Why? We need it. Seriously. Is it now being sold under another name? I need this soap. Something they put in liquid soaps people with Sensitive skin absolutely cannot tolerate. Please bring back the bar.

I've always had very dry super sensitive skin, prone to breakouts. I'm now in my mid 30s and I have been using tretinoin for acne and wrinkles. It is helping tremendously, but is very drying to my already dry skin. This face wash (in extra mild for very dry to dry skin) has literally changed my life. I have been using it morning and night for the past 6 months, and my skin has never felt more hydrated. The soap is so creamy, it feels like you are washing with moisturizer. If you struggle with dry, flaking skin this face wash is a must!

extraits.titre: Great for my acne prone skin
extraits.texte: This cleanser works great, I noticed a difference in my skin after the first wash. I struggle with hormonal acne and have always had large pores and kinda dull looking skin. Even after the first wash with this cleanser, my pores were noticeably smaller and my skin glowed. Very impressed!

I've tried numerous facial cleansers, but they either leave my already dry skin dry or make it too oily, leading to breakouts. However, this cleanser is the best. My skin is silky, supple, and well-hydrated without being oily. I haven't had any breakouts or blackheads. It's perfect for my super-sensitive skin.

This stuff is the best! I've been using this for about 3 years now, and I will never buy another face wash! I have oily skin in the summertime, and more combination skin in the colder months, but it works for my skin year round! It really gets your face clean, and one bottle will last me almost six months! A little goes a long way. For the longevity, i believe the price is justified! I swear by this face wash!

extraits.titre: Bring back the oily skin bar soap
extraits.texte: I had been using the bar soap for oily skin for years and it did a great job of removing all oil, dirt and leftover makeup from my skin. Clinique is no longer selling that product and the liquid face soap for "oily skin" is just not the same. Doesn't leave that squeaky clean feeling that the other soap did and I'm highly disappointed in the results after using for over a month. If you have very oily skin like I do, this product just doesn't cut it. Not to mention this product is at a much higher price point than the bar soap was. Will not be repurchasing this product. Clinique please bring back the bar soap or I'll be taking my business elsewhere.
My go to for cleansers. My face is somehow oily and dry in different places and this soap has been able to clean and moisturize my face without causing even a little bit of irritation!
